standingLines.line: ◈ SYSTEM: "RATINGS DIP. The audience wants STAKES — pointed ones. A PALISADE. Stockpile 14,000 kcal, 350 wood and 60 stone. Walls make such good television. You will thank us when the teeth come."
📺 RATINGS ARE UP! The producers are pleased. New casting directives incoming — Wave 2 talent has been released into your sector.

💛 You hold Field suture kit. You practiced on an orange. 'People are just oranges that bleed,' your instructor said, and then taught you how to not flinch. You haven't flinched since. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)
📺 ● LIVE — THE FEAST. the whole village are on television.
📺 🎙️ PLAY-BY-PLAY: And we are LIVE with a special presentation: THE FEAST! The little ones are putting flavored matter in their mouths ON PURPOSE. For joy. The file says joy.

🍖 FEAST 📺 — Diana opens the pantry wide: 12× Foraged food. George, Zhanibek, Natalia eat until the fire burns low. Nobody says what this cost — everybody knows. For one evening, the pantry is lighter and the people are not. (−2,400 kcal from the pantry) Tom stayed in their tent, feverish; Nino stayed in their tent, feverish. The channeled keepsake feeds the feast — the feast was the weapon, and the surge rides the fire until tomorrow's dawn, spent only when the blades are warmed. (FEAST SURGE ×1.5 armed)
🍖 FEASTED ×2.03 until tomorrow's dawn (6 parts left): a proper feast. A channeled keepsake feeds the flames (devotion ×1.5). Strikes and abilities hit with the feast behind them.

📺 The Alibi Chain. Five villagers, each vouched for by the next, a chain that ends at midnight. One link is false. Break the chain before the chain breaks the village.

People have been hurt in this one. Not always.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

The chain, read aloud:

George vouches for Zhanibek. Zhanibek vouches for Natalia. Natalia vouches for Tom. Tom vouches for Luis.

One of those vouches is a lie. The System: "FIND THE FALSE LINK BEFORE MIDNIGHT. THE VILLAGE SLEEPS UNDER WHATEVER YOU LEAVE STANDING."
